description: banshee, a wailing female ghost floating above the ground, long wild flowing white hair, gaunt pale blue-grey face with dark hollow eyes and a mouth wide open in a scream, thin bare arms with long bony fingers, tattered grey-white burial gown whose hem dissolves into ragged wisps of mist instead of feet, faint cold blue glow, dark fantasy

werelion, a lion-headed beast-man: a full lion head with a lion muzzle, black nose, fangs and round lion ears, a huge shaggy dark brown mane, the whole body covered in tawny lion fur, muscular, bronze shoulder plate, torn red loincloth, a lion tail with a dark tuft, big clawed paws for hands and feet, glowing amber eyes, dark fantasy

leaf golem, a big hulking construct with no skin and no face, its whole body built of thick brown tree bark, twisted branches and roots, covered by dense clusters of bright green leaves and moss, two small glowing green eyes in a hollow of the bark head, long heavy log arms with wooden fists, stump legs, dark fantasy
